a.lede: The UK's former chief technology officer says the Department for Work and Pensions may have been hit by hackers, but the government has not confirmed that.
a.title: Pensions and benefits services still down after 'cyber incident'

b.lede: Department for Work and Pensions urges people to be alert to scams related to outage and contact helpline with urgent difficulties Tell us: have you been affected by the DWP ‘cyber incident’ Benefits and pensions claimants have faced chaos after the system was hit by a “serious cyber incident”, fuelling concerns about the UK government’s ability to defend itself against
b.title: DWP ‘cyber incident’ knocks almost all pensions and benefits systems offline
